about: Cases for how much an inbox thread wants Mike (urgency, lowest first) and whether it counts in the badge. The Mac (ThreadSections, ThreadbearCoreTests/InboxUrgencyTests.swift), the phone (InboxSections, ThreadbearKitTests/InboxUrgencyTests.swift) and the website (web/src/sections.ts, sections.test.ts) all run every case through their own inbox code. The rule is app/Sources/ThreadbearCore/Threads/InboxUrgency.swift. Each thread is short: status (idle when absent), needsYou, unread, pendingReviews. counted is whether it's in the badge (the website's Needs you filter).
